valid_for.lidar: RS-Fairy, config.yaml as of 2026-10-11, mounted facing forward

method: measure_sync_offset.py, 3 daylight sessions, LiDAR reference, --lidar-range-pct 10 (plate surface); pct 20 gave radar +12.67 ms
note: offsets are ADDED to each sensor's time. Re-measure if firmware/frame period, DCA delay, camera mode or LiDAR config changes. altos_ms: the Altos's processing + transmission delay (its times are frame arrivals); re-measure if its profile, threshold or firmware changes.

altos.session: offset-session (recorded as run_20261126_1225, 2026-11-25, 2.2 min, someone walking towards and away from the rig, 2.6-11.9 m)
altos.method: whole-session range lag against the LiDAR target track: r_altos(t) = r_lidar(t + tau) + c, Altos range = median of its moving points within 1 m / 25 deg of the LiDAR target; tau = -64 ms, bootstrap sd 3.3 ms (3 s blocks); -56..-66 ms across gates and session halves. Control: the TI radar's detections by the same method gave +2 +- 13 ms with its offset applied. The report's 30 s Doppler windows could not resolve it on this walk (steady legs, information only at the turns).
